entities.summary: Alberto Bovone was an Italian Cardinal of the Catholic Church. He served as Prefect of the Congregation for the Causes of Saints from 1995 until his death. Pope John Paul II elevated Bovone to the cardinalate in 1998, shortly before his death in 1998.
